messages:
Noah: Heads-up — I'm updating the Region Availability page with a short "locale phrasebook" and a compact SDK example that demonstrates overriding the target region. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/907 . Need review on wording for APAC residency and the sample code.

Priya (Docs): Pinged. Can you keep the residency blurb ≤110 chars for i18n? Also prefer the header pattern `X-Redwood-Region` in examples rather than query params. I'll tidy tone after legal sign-off.

Omar (Platform): Confirming header is preferred. For examples, use the canonical region id `apac-sg-1` where applicable. Also note: private deployments use a different base URL — show only header + generic api url to avoid confusion. Suggested curl: 

```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: apac-sg-1" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  https://api.redwood.run/v1/chat/completions
```

i18n-bot: Reminder — short string limit configured at 120 chars for translations. Longer strings will create extra translation work.

Noah: OK trimming to 100-110 chars. Also want to add a tiny country matrix row: "Supported: Singapore, Japan (preview), Australia" — will that be OK for the data-residency note?

Rachel (Legal): Do not imply guarantees. Use this sentence for logs: "Request logs are retained for up to 30 days for operational troubleshooting and abuse prevention." Avoid words like "stored in" or "kept in-country." For contractual residency requirements, direct customers to Sales/Support.

Priya (Docs): Thanks Rachel — I'll insert that exact line. Also I'll add a brief parenthetical: "(contact support for contractual residency guarantees)" under the matrix.

Kevin: One more technical note — there are legacy snippets in `/docs/samples/region-examples.md` that use `region=` query param. We should replace those in this PR or file a follow-up issue. Consistency is important for SDK examples.

Noah: I'll update the PR to switch examples to header-first and keep one note about private-base-url differences. Will @Maria-L10N once text is final so she can prepare i18n keys.

Priya (Docs): When you push the update, please include both Python and JS tiny snippets. For example JS: 

```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
client.setRegion('apac-sg-1');
await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] });
```

Noah: Will do. Expecting to push in ~45 min. CI: docs-link-check and i18n-lint will run. I'll add QA checklist in the PR description. :rocket:
